messages:
Nina (AE): Client 'OpalSurge' wants a 10-day POC for a support agent. They'll test 'opal-compat-13b-quant' + a fallback non-quant model. Need compatibility check, quick cost est, and SSQ answers by Thu.
Cal (Infra): Should run on sandbox. Checklist: tokenizer match, KV cache warm-up, and batch tuning. Expect ~28-32GB VRAM on T4s, ~30-36GB on A100.
Sana (Security): SSQ highlights: encryption at rest, tenant isolation, audit logs, SOC2. Sandbox retention 5-7d, production 30d by default (enterprise can extend).
Vik (Solutions): I'll produce a 1-page compatibility summary with recommended batch=2-6, max_seq=1024, and a short curl + kv check.
Nina (AE): Pricing Q: ~1M tokens/day POC. Quant variant: any token billing diff?
Cal (Infra): Token billing same. Quant affects GPU cost. Ballpark shared-hosted POC = $0.09/k tokens; dedicated ~30% cheaper depending on commit. I'll confirm exact numbers.
Sana (Security): They asked about model provenance and third-party licenses. We verify catalog models; custom weights require attestation via legal.
Vik (Solutions): Smoke test curl:

```bash
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD-OPAL-POC" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"opal-compat-13b-quant","prompt":"Answer: What is the refund policy?","max_tokens":64}'
```

Vik (Solutions): KV warmup: `python tools/kv_warmup.py --model opal-compat-13b-quant --runs 25 --seq 512`
provision-bot: sandbox/opal-2026 provisioned on cluster-b (A100), token REDWOOD-OPAL-POC, status: ready :white_check_mark:
Nina (AE): Assignments: Vik -> compatibility note + scripts. Cal -> smoke runs + precise pricing. Sana -> SSQ draft. I'll compile and send to OpalSurge once done.
Cal (Infra): starting quick run now, will post latencies in ~20m.
Sana (Security): drafting SSQ answers, flagging legal for attestation. ETA EOD Wed.
Nina (AE): Thanks all. I'll schedule a kickoff after we share the bundle. :calendar:
